CC: ingrown toenail and unrelated lesser-toe corn
HPI: weeks of symptoms relating to painful plantar callus. Patient also reports a distinct symptom requiring separate evaluation.
Exam: plantar callus area consistent with painful plantar callus. Additional finding: mild tenderness at a separate site.
MDM: addressed an independent problem with risks, data review (X-ray pending), and a management plan distinct from the procedure decision; shared decision making documented.
Procedure: Paring of single hyperkeratotic lesion performed (RT modifier documented). Tolerated well, no immediate complications.
